title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1984-04-27
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Sennheiser 421's (X-Y Cross) And 2 Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns (Spread) > Unknown Mixer > Sony D5, Tapes:Set 1 Maxell UDXLII - 90, Set 2 TDK MA - 90, Tapes Labelled:Master - Ross; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate V.3.0.2 To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Super‑fine Providence show captured on an excellent soundboard recording with standout Althea, China Doll/High Time and a ripping second set.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about both the performance and the tape, calling it a “very fine recording from Mr. Hill” and highlighting the great playing throughout the two‑night run in Providence. Specific songs such as Althea, China Doll/High Time, Playing in the Band and Wharf Rat are singled out as highlights, especially in an outstanding second set.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and recording quality, indicating an exceptional show with excellent sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the tape as a “very fine recording” with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Whole show praised as great; second set especially highlighted for its energy and song flow.
